info.title: ReShow EE3070 Backend API
info.description: ReShow university backend v0.4.1. Staff calls use /staff-api with Cognito access tokens and current account permissions. Operators can read exhibit scans; Operators and Viewers receive an allowlisted operational activity feed and non-card command state. Staff-card scans, card commands and sensitive staff activity remain Administrator-only. The shared /api token is restricted to configured synthetic producer data. Device-scoped hardware tokens authorize only real status and reading uploads for their registered device. Historical exhibit attribution, current-time cutoffs, explicit device recovery and immutable report captures are preserved. Hardware firmware and integration of the six demonstration data screens remain separate.

get.description: Strong primary-key read. No query parameters. Compare this record with the uploaded payload before submitting coverage.

Select event_id OR device_id,start,end. Optional exhibit_id filters proximity, warnings and display details using unambiguous historical display intervals. Same-exhibit overlaps are unioned; conflicting IDs and display gaps are unattributed. Selected completeness denominator includes selected known-display plus unknown/conflicting assignment time, excludes known-other time, and requires both stream and display completion coverage. One captured time caps evaluated records; later requested hours remain future with null metrics, never missing/quiet. Top start/end retain requested bounds; evaluation returns requested/effective UTC ranges. 31 elapsed days, 2048 requested-grid buckets, 10000 source records or attributed detail fragments, 4 MB body/5.5 MB proxy envelope caps remain. Use interval_minutes=60 for a 31-day desktop heatmap; 15-minute defaults exceed the bucket cap. Reports are detection-zone activity, not unique visitors or attention.

parameters.description: Select an existing event. Supply event_id OR the full device_id,start,end selector; mixing selectors is rejected.

parameters.name: device_id
parameters.description: Required together with start and end when event_id is absent. One device per report.

parameters.name: start

schema.description: UTC timestamp normalized to six fractional digits.

parameters.description: Inclusive UTC start required with device_id. Maximum selected range 31 days.

parameters.name: end

schema.description: UTC timestamp normalized to six fractional digits.

parameters.description: Exclusive requested UTC end. May extend beyond capture time within the 31-day/requested-bucket limits. See evaluation for the effective cutoff; wholly future returns no evaluated range.

parameters.name: interval_minutes
parameters.description: Requested grid uses fixed elapsed UTC intervals. Default15; use60 for up to31days (15-minute31day requests exceed2048buckets). Current bucket metrics stop at evaluated_end and future_seconds is excluded.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Available IANA time zone for local labels, for example Asia/Hong_Kong or UTC. UTC bucket membership is unchanged.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Export format. CSV contains typed section rows with a JSON detail column. Null values are empty cells. Free text that could be interpreted as a spreadsheet formula is prefixed with a single quote.

parameters.name: exhibit_id
parameters.description: Optional stable logical exhibit ID. Attribute by unambiguous producer display intervals only, splitting occupied duration at changes. Count the original start only for the exhibit displayed then. Current profile assignment is not historical evidence.

200.description: Computed result from recorded intervals and producer coverage. No report is stored or sent.

example.bucket_alignment: fixed elapsed UTC intervals beginning at requested start; final bucket may be shorter
example.interval_semantics: half-open [start,end); event counts count starts only; occupied duration merges overlapping events
example.snapshot_semantics: Each timeline page is strongly consistent; concurrent uploads can change a multi-page report. Re-run after uploads finish.

data_quality.display_history_note: Display intervals are producer-reported history, not an independent acknowledgement of physical display. Overlaps may indicate conflicting producer records; exhibit profiles are resolved with GET /api/exhibits/{exhibit_id}.

limitations: Proximity records describe detection-zone activity, not unique visitors, viewing attention or per-person dwell time. Groups and stationary objects may trigger one event.
Only completed, producer-reported intervals are included. Point readings do not establish event duration, complete uploads or sustained environmental warnings.
Coverage certifies that all records for the named stream and interval were uploaded. Incomplete coverage makes recorded counts and durations lower bounds; absent coverage is not confirmed quiet.
Warnings are supplied by the producer after its configured persistence logic. This API does not infer or verify that hardware logic.
Sources marked demo are synthetic test data and do not prove hardware operation or human participation.
The shared bearer token is a demonstration credential, not individual staff accounts or role-based access control.
